_doc: Config for scripts/github/review-router.mjs (P3c, DW-80). Spec: artifacts/ccv3-review-economy/router-spec.md.
classes: path globs per risk class. Only ** (any number of whole path segments, also zero), * (inside one segment) and ? are special.

A glob that starts with ! is an exclusion for that class (r3 excludes eval fixtures under .claude/skills/**/evals/**). Each path gets the first class that matches it, in this order: r3, infra, steering, docs.
A path that matches no class is normal. The PR class is the highest class of any path. risk:high is never set from paths: a person adds it.
deep_enabled false: steering, infra, high and r3 PRs get review:coderabbit + review:deep-held, not review:deep (spec 4.1, Apex billing D3).
greptile.credits_used_manual: Greptile credits used this period, an integer you edit by hand. null means unknown: the router skips the u1 and u2 steps and the ledger says so.
greptile.u1_used: at or above this count, a review:deep PR gets a warning in the router comment.
greptile.u2_used: at or above this count, only r3 PRs get review:deep. Other deep classes get the held labels. Needs deep_enabled true.

greptile.u3_date: on or after this date, a deep-class PR gets one credit-check line in the router comment, but only while credits_used_manual is null. A known count means the check is done, so no line.
greptile.notify_login: GitHub login named in the u1 and u3 lines. null means nobody is pinged.
budget: CodeRabbit PR reviews per class as [opening, extra after a Major] (pr-review-loop.md 'PR review budget per class'). Read by scripts/github/pr-checkpoint.mjs. A bare number is [n, 0].

checkpoint.critical: path globs of files whose PR gets Greptile too when it is available (pr-checkpoint.mjs rule R3). A PR that touches one never takes the READY carry (review-status.mjs). Extended 2026-10-30 with the files where a fix added a real Major (.claudedocs/2026-10-30-coderabbit-rereview-study.md section 4).
checkpoint.parser: path globs of hand-written lexer and parser guards. Their PR gets one CodeRabbit review and no loop (rule R2). Dave edits this list.

checkpoint.enforce: boolean, read by the pre-pr-gate hook from the checkout the session runs in. true (live since PR D, 2026-10-29): the checkpoint rules (non-draft create, shell gh pr ready, hand review: label, self-confirm, non-literal --repo) deny the command. false (warn mode): the same commands pass and log one warn row to guard-decisions.jsonl. Only a literal true enforces. The stamp rules are enforced in both modes.

checkpoint.autoConfirm: the kill switch for the auto-confirm of /pathway (review factory step A, Dave 2026-11-01). Three values. The word low (ships so, Dave 2026-11-06): band LOW only. The literal true: band LOW, MID or ELEVATED (the first switch, Dave 2026-11-01). false, missing or anything else: every checkpoint waits for Dave. When on, the pr_checkpoint tool records `none` itself (decided_by auto, a toast and a note for the model) for a PR in a covered band that is recommended none, whose config matches main, whose labels were read and that touches no matrix.security_tier or checkpoint.critical file (the spec 3.1 floor: aegis + critic before READY). HIGH and CRITICAL always wait for Dave's press. Until this config matches main, config_drift is set and auto-confirm stays off. Read by scripts/github/pr-checkpoint.mjs (autoOf).

checkpoint.ledger: boolean, the two-call protocol of the PR checkpoint (pathway-flow-v2, Dave 2026-11-06). Only a literal true turns it on. It is true since 2026-11-07 (Dave, after the phone proof .claude/cache/e2e/2026-11-07-pathway-v2-phone-proof.md). false: pr-checkpoint.mjs --json prints the result as before and the mod's own dialog asks the review question. true: --json --pr N also prints a `ledger` block (the AskUserQuestion spec the model asks), and --confirm by dave records only when Dave's tap for that pathway is in the decision store (a paid pathway also needs his Yes on the paid confirm). Needs the decision-ledger hook registered in settings. Read by scripts/github/pr-checkpoint.mjs. Flip it only after Dave's yes and the first phone run.

decisions.enforce: boolean, the land check (pathway-flow-v2, Dave 2026-11-06). Only a literal true enforces. It is true since 2026-11-07 (Dave, after the Esc test). false: the decision-gate hook and land-pr.ps1 print a warning and do not refuse. true: they refuse a PR create, a land or a merge that has no tap of Dave's for its head. Read by decision-gate and land-pr.ps1 (land-pr.ps1 enforces when either -RepoPath or its own checkout says true). Flip order, with Dave's yes: merge this change to main first, with both flags false. Then register the hooks and run one phone flow. Then flip checkpoint.ledger and decisions.enforce to true in one commit on main.

coderabbit.cli_daily_cap_usd: the daily cap in dollars on paid CodeRabbit CLI runs (Dave, 2026-11-02). CLI 0.9.0 bills usage credits past the free hourly allowance with no flag and no prompt. pre-pr.mjs and cr-fix.mjs log each billed run (usageCost) as a kind:cli row in ~/.claude/state/coderabbit-paid.jsonl and sum today's cli rows (America/Chicago) before a run. At or over the cap they start no run: pre-pr SKIPs with cr_skip_reason cli-cap (the pre-pr-gate hook accepts it) and cr-fix stops with exit 2. A missing or non-number value means no cap. A cap of 0 blocks every CLI run. At the cap, free runs also skip for the rest of that Chicago day, because the check runs before the review. The PR day cap in cr-paid.mjs counts PR rows only.

coderabbit.monthly_file_cap: the month cap on CodeRabbit PR files (interim rule, Dave 2026-11-04; $0.25 a file, $50 a month). The checkpoint recommends no CodeRabbit PR review when the month-to-date files in ~/.claude/state/coderabbit-paid.jsonl (PR rows, America/Chicago month; node scripts/github/cr-paid.mjs month) plus the reviewable files of this PR are over the cap. The ledger records paid rounds only, so the count undercounts reviews that used a free slot. An unreadable ledger also stops the recommendation. Dave can still press CodeRabbit by hand.

coderabbit.reviews_7d_manual: CodeRabbit PR reviews in the last 7 days, an integer Dave sets from the free '@coderabbitai rate limit' reply or the dashboard CSV export. null means unknown and changes no rule. reviews_7d_manual_date: the day Dave read it. A count older than 7 days counts as unknown. Since 2026-11-06 it is only the fallback: the live capacity fact (capacity block below) wins when it is known.

capacity.post_rate_limit_probe: true lets the checkpoint post one free '@coderabbitai rate limit' comment on the PR when no notice under 60 minutes old and no cache under 5 minutes old is known (Dave 2026-11-06). It is not a review. Never posted for a Dependabot PR or a PR with no number. false, or the env var PR_CHECKPOINT_NO_PROBE=1, turns it off. Read by scripts/github/lib/capacity-fact.mjs.

matrix: the review band (.claudedocs/2026-11-01-review-matrix.md, option A). review-router.mjs bandOf() reads it. No matrix block means no band, and pr-checkpoint.mjs keeps its old rules R2 to R5. Since Dave's interim rule (2026-11-04) only a PR with the risk:high label, or a CRITICAL PR that changes a CRITICAL_TRUST_BOUNDARY or matrix.security_tier file, is recommended the CodeRabbit PR bot. A docs-only PR never is.

matrix.control_plane: path globs of the gate files (G). It holds every checkpoint.critical and checkpoint.parser glob, plus the review tooling, the pr-checkpoint and pr-loop mods, the tool.call registrants and the guard helpers (spec 2.2). Any extension counts. A test file never counts. Dave edits this list.
matrix.security_tier: subset of control_plane. The band output names these files. They set an internal review floor, not a bot floor (option A).

matrix.config_files: path globs of review, merge and reviewer config (C = 1 when one changes). matrix.test_markers: a path that contains one of these is a test file (weight 0). matrix.logic_ext: extensions of logic files (K = 1 when the PR has one outside dist/ and test files).

matrix.gate_score: [min G, score] steps, the highest step reached wins. matrix.weights: config is the C weight, code is the K weight. Score S = gate score + config * C + code * K + R. R is +7 per confirmed internal Major (passed to bandOf; nothing posts it yet).

matrix.bands: the lowest score of MID, ELEVATED and HIGH. Score 0 is LOW. CRITICAL comes from a risk:high label or a path of the r3 class, at any score. matrix.bot_budget: CodeRabbit PR reviews [opening, extra after a Major] for a PR that earns the bot. Interim rule (Dave 2026-11-04): only the risk:high label, or CRITICAL plus a CRITICAL_TRUST_BOUNDARY or matrix.security_tier file, earns it; a docs-only PR never does; HIGH by gate files alone gets none, so the HIGH entry is not used today. The extra round is free-slot only.

matrix.slot: the free-slot queue (scripts/github/slot-queue.mjs). spacing_min is the floor between free CodeRabbit posts; paid_after_min starts the CRITICAL paid ask; timeout_min marks an item timed-out (no READY effect before engine P2); holder_max_min expires a post that made no review; sample_ttl_hours is read by the shadow sync, which runs slot-queue.mjs drop --reason sample-ttl.
